purpose: Consumer reference to the shared P15 r1 module owned by zudo-pd. It records which external source the LED path uses; it does not make P15 part of this repository's inventory, and a hash match is not electrical, mechanical, programmed or physical acceptance.

owner.record_commit_note: First zudo-pd commit carrying the record (branch claude/project-thread-bgdr5q, pending the zudo-pd integration PR); hashes were re-read at zudo-pd main 6b08236a30331659756ca6a9af492e59f3fc6061

led_side.board: boards/board-l/ (two units from the 2026-09-19 order, reused unchanged; RS1 200 mOhm)
led_side.interface: Board L J2 mates P15 JOUT1.1-6 (VBUS_OUT x2, ATT, PDOK, GND x2); orientation is unkeyed and must be verified
led_side.interface_owner: zudo-led-lamp owns Board L J2 and the enclosure; zudo-pd owns P15 JOUT1

historical_board_p.note: As-ordered 2026-09-19 LED Board P (STUSB4500, issues #143/#144). Historical; never P15 and never zudo-pd's 20 V Board P r3. Bytes preserved.

acceptance_owner: zudo-pd doc/src/content/docs/architecture/board-p15-programming.md: every P15 unit passes P15-NVM-1 to -7 before it mates with a Board L
